name: Solar panel scenarios
summary: A model of how much electricity a standard 1 kWp solar panel set would make in an average year in each of the four cities. A worked example, not a measurement of any roof.

el.name: Σενάρια φωτοβολταϊκών
el.summary: Ένα μοντέλο για το πόσο ρεύμα θα παρήγαγε ένα τυπικό σύστημα φωτοβολταϊκών (1 kWp) σε ένα μέσο έτος σε καθεμία από τις τέσσερις πόλεις. Παράδειγμα υπολογισμού, όχι μέτρηση κάποιας στέγης.

licence.attribution: PVGIS, European Commission Joint Research Centre

update.note: A fixed calculation for one scenario. The server reads a reviewed copy kept in context/ and does not call PVGIS.

quality.uncertainty: A model for a generic point in each city from the weather of 2005 to 2023. Real roofs differ: shade, direction, dirt and the weather of one year.
known_issues: One scenario only: 1 kWp, 14 % losses, tilted 30 degrees, facing south
The four results come from the same model, so they are not four independent sources

restrictions: Credit PVGIS (European Commission, Joint Research Centre) wherever this is shown
Never present it as what a school produces, never rank schools with it, never use it for costs

use_for: A feel for how much a solar panel can make in Cyprus, month by month
not_for: What a real roof or a school produces
Ranking the cities or the schools

notes: Four PVGIS 5.3 calculations from the research handoff of 13 November 2026, kept byte for byte as context/pv-solar-scenarios.json (hash in context/manifest.json). JRC says PVGIS information is free to use with acknowledgement: that is the provider's statement, not a formal licence, so commercial use is left unknown. Read by context.js. The brain does not read this layer (x_reads).
